nonPromotableReason: The access boundary depends on the actual host sandbox and session permissions, which the approved static verifiers cannot model without a real per-context access probe.
summary: A separate Windows account was presented as necessary before the P-3 clean-room contract and the actual local sandbox boundary had been tested.
prevention: Treat a clean-room boundary as valid only after testing the exact execution context against the other condition worktree and common Git storage; do not substitute an untested operating-system account claim for that evidence.
